Remark
[failure for Ricci or scalar curvature bounds]

Source: petersen:page-0258 ↗ thm:pet-ch6-cartan-hadamard No analogue of section 2 holds under $\operatorname {Ric}\le 0$ or $\operatorname {scal}\le 0$ in place of $\sec \le 0$: there exist Ricci-flat metrics on $\mathbb {R}^2\times S^{n-2}$ and scalar-flat metrics on $\mathbb {R}\times S^{n-1}$.
